articles.headline: Fantasy football matchup rankings: Upgrade Ladd McConkey, Brock Purdy in Week 3
articles.description: The most and least favorable matchups in the NFL for this week's games at the four key fantasy positions.
articles.headlineJa: ファンタジー・フットボール対戦ランキング：第3週はラッド・マッコンキーとブロック・パーディを評価引き上げ
articles.descriptionJa: 今週のNFLの試合における、ファンタジーの主要4ポジションで最も有利な対戦と最も厳しい対戦。
articles.body:
Making tough lineup decisions each week can be the most challenging part of the fantasy football process. When you're torn between two similar players and simply don't know which one to start, start the player with the superior matchup.

Ah, but exactly how does one determine the best (and worst) weekly matchups?

The matchup rankings provide a schedule-independent method to evaluate positional matchups each week, ranking all 32 opposing defenses in order of most to least favorable for opposing players at the four skill positions (quarterback, running back, wide receiver and tight end). Instead of relying on season totals, we calibrate points-allowed data to show how each defense fared relative to the difficulty of the schedule it has faced. This provides a more fair approach to judging the quality of individual matchups.

For the first three weeks, these rankings account for two things: my own opinion of the strength of that matchup, and what ESPN's projections tell us about it. As an additional reference point, 2025 full-season data is provided.

"Adj. FPA," or adjusted fantasy points allowed, reflects how far above or below players' weekly PPR fantasy point averages that defense held opponents at that position. A positive number means the matchup is favorable; a negative number means it is unfavorable. Also, remember teams often use multiple running backs and wide receivers in a game, and these plus/minus averages cover all of a team's personnel at that position.

Finally, a caveat: Matchups are only one ingredient in my rankings formula. Not every favorable matchup should be exploited, nor every unfavorable matchup avoided. If you want my -- and the ESPN fantasy staff's -- most complete source for whom to start and sit each week, consult our weekly rankings.

Quarterbacks

Matchups highlight: Brock Purdy, San Francisco 49ers (vs. Arizona Cardinals). Purdy leads the league in Total QBR (95.7), completion percentage (80.4%) and off-target percentage (zero off-target throws thus far), and he's one of five quarterbacks to score 20-plus fantasy points in each of the first two weeks. (*Extra credit for those who can name the five.) Purdy next faces the Cardinals, a defense that, while solid in a Week 1 upset of the Los Angeles Chargers, surrendered 21.40 fantasy points to Drew Lock in Week 2. The Cardinals have afforded quarterbacks the ninth-most points per passing attempt.

Others to like:

Sam Darnold/Lock, Seattle Seahawks (at Washington Commanders) 

Bryce Young, Carolina Panthers (at Cleveland Browns)

Matchup to avoid: Matthew Stafford, Los Angeles Rams (at Denver Broncos). Give him all due credit for his stateside, bounce-back Week 2 (26.98 fantasy points), in which he looked like his 2025 MVP self despite the absence of No. 1 receiver, Puka Nacua. articles.headline: NBA Rank 2026, players Nos. 50-11: Where LeBron, Steph, KD check in
articles.description: Our countdown of the NBA's top 100 players continues. See which stars just missed a spot in the top 10 -- and where three legends land.
articles.headlineJa: NBAランキング2026（50位〜11位）：レブロン、ステフ、KDは何位にランクインしたか
articles.descriptionJa: NBAトップ100選手のカウントダウンは続きます。トップ10入りを惜しくも逃したスター選手たちや、3人のレジェンドが何位にランクインしたかをご覧ください。
articles.body:
NBA Rank is back! With less than one month until opening night, let's continue counting down the league's best players for 2026-27.

After unveiling players Nos. 100-51 on Tuesday, our rankings now enter the top 50. It's a group headlined by former MVPs, future first-ballot Hall of Famers and young stars expected to take major leaps this season.  

It's also where LeBron James checks in, his first time outside the top 10 in NBA Rank's 15-year history. (You can jump to LeBron's NBA Rank here.)

The rankings rollout concludes Thursday with our expert panel's top 10 players. And that panel has been overhauled for the 2026 edition.

In previous seasons, more than 100 ESPN NBA insiders, reporters, editors and producers voted on thousands of possible player vs. player matchups to arrive at the final top-100 list. That "wisdom of the crowd" approach has given way to the wisdom of seven: ESPN's Ben Golliver, Vincent Goodwill, Zach Kram, Bobby Marks, Dave McMenamin, André Snellings and Matt "Stats" Williams. (The panelists' individual top-100 lists were combined to create our final rankings.)

Voting guidelines, however, remained unchanged. The panel was asked to rank players based on predicted contributions -- quality and quantity -- for the 2026-27 regular season only.

Let's get to the list, which features plenty of superstars who just missed our top 10.

Note: Signature stats provided by ESPN Research.

50. Dylan Harper

G | San Antonio Spurs

Age: 20

2025 NBA Rank: NR

The youngest member of the Spurs was the one who seemed to rise highest in the altitude of the Finals and stands to make a big jump in Year 2, whether he stays coming off the bench or makes the leap to the first five. He will earn more respect from the officials (1.7 free throw attempts in 69 games as a rookie), take a bigger role in the offense and improve on his already-respectable playmaking. Harper is an All-Star in the making. -- Vincent Goodwill

Signature stat: Harper had six games with at least 15 points and 65% shooting from the field in the 2026 playoffs, the most by a guard in NBA postseason history.

Fantasy projection: 15.2 PTS, 5.0 AST, 4.4 REB

49. Lauri Markkanen

F | Utah Jazz

Age: 29

2025 NBA Rank: 43

Markkanen, a scoring forward who can stretch the court, has languished as a forgotten man in Utah. The Finnish star's competence often came into conflict with the Jazz's desire to improve their draft positioning during a multiyear rebuilding effort, and he has appeared in only one game in April over the past four seasons. Though his contract is overly generous for a player lacking All-NBA credentials, Markkanen should benefit from Utah's recent talent upgrades as he eyes his first career postseason appearance. -- Ben Golliver

Signature stat: Markkanen has nine seasons with at least 100 3-pointers, tied with Karl-Anthony Towns and Dirk Nowitzki for the most by a 7-footer in NBA history.

Fantasy projection: 23.8 PTS, 7.2 REB, 1.9 AST

48. Kon Knueppel

articles.headline: Sources: Panthers RB Jonathon Brooks set for surgery, IR move
articles.description: Panthers running back Jonathon Brooks is expected to undergo surgery to repair a core muscle injury and is set to miss at least six weeks, sources told NFL Network.
articles.headlineJa: パンサーズRBジョナソン・ブルックス、手術とIR入りへ（関係者情報）
articles.descriptionJa: NFLネットワークが関係者の話として報じたところによると、パンサーズのランニングバック（RB）ジョナソン・ブルックスは体幹筋肉の損傷を修復する手術を受ける見込みで、少なくとも6週間離脱する予定です。
articles.body:
Carolina Panthers running back Jonathon Brooks is expected to undergo core muscle surgery Wednesday and land on injured reserve, sources told NFL Network's Ian Rapoport.

He will be sidelined for at least six weeks, sources said.

With Brooks out, the Panthers are bringing in former Los Angeles Chargers and Washington Commanders running back Austin Ekeler for a workout, league sources told ESPN, confirming a report by KPRC 2.

Brooks left Sunday's win over the Atlanta Falcons in the fourth quarter with what was described as a groin injury. The third-year running back walked to the tunnel with a towel over his head with three members of the Panthers' staff. He was later seen favoring the injury as he slowly limped, on his own power, to the locker room following the game.

Brooks, a second-round pick in 2024, returned this season from back-to-back ACL surgeries. He missed the bulk of his rookie season while recovering from the first surgery on his right knee, an injury that occurred during his final year at Texas. After playing in just three games as a rookie, he retore his right ACL in December 2024 and was forced to undergo another procedure, which sidelined him for the entire 2025 season.

He took part in training camp and the preseason this summer for the first time in his NFL career. He sustained a groin injury leading up to Week 1 but was able to play against the Chicago Bears in the season opener.

In two games this season, Brooks produced 30 rushing yards on nine carries and 43 receiving yards on two catches.

With Brooks sidelined for at least six weeks, the best-case scenario might mean he misses only five games, as the Panthers have an early bye in Week 5.

The Panthers have leaned heavily on veteran Chuba Hubbard as the starting running back this season. Hubbard has rushed for 102 yards and a touchdown and caught five passes for 49 yards and two touchdowns. He will continue to carry the load in the backfield with veteran AJ Dillon serving as a change-of-pace option.

Anthony Tyus III has been on the practice squad in each of the past two seasons, and he was featured heavily throughout the preseason. Ahmani Marshall, a second-year running back, is also on the practice squad.

articles.headline: Man United transfer strategy 'financial sustainable' as losses increase - CEO
articles.description: Manchester United's summer transfer strategy had "financial sustainability in mind," according to CEO Omar Berrada, after reporting a increased financial losses.
articles.headlineJa: 赤字拡大もマンチェスター・ユナイテッドの移籍戦略は「財政的に持続可能」とCEOが主張
articles.descriptionJa: 赤字の拡大が報告されたのを受け、マンチェスター・ユナイテッドのオマル・ベラダCEOは、今夏の移籍戦略は「財政的な持続可能性を念頭に置いたもの」だったと述べた。
articles.body:
Manchester United's summer transfer strategy had "financial sustainability in mind," according to CEO Omar Berrada, after the club reported increased financial losses.

On Wednesday, United posted record full year revenues of £677.6m ($900m) and an operating profit of £22.6m ($30m).

However, the club still reported an overall loss of £43m ($57m), up from £33m ($44m) the previous year.

Borrowing increased by £95m to a total of £583m.

United spent £155m ($206m) midfielders Andrey Santos, Youri Tielemans and Carlos Baleba in the transfer window.

Big six rivals Manchester City, Liverpool, Arsenal, Tottenham and Chelsea all spent considerably more with City, Liverpool, Tottenham and Chelsea all spending at least £100m ($133) on one player.

And speaking as the club's fourth quarter and full year financial results were published on Wednesday, Berrada hinted at a need for a prudent approach to transfers.

"While these results confirm that we are on the right trajectory, we will continue to take a disciplined approach to ensure our finances remain sustainable," said Berrada.

"With that financial sustainability in mind, we have strengthened both our men's and women's teams during the summer window and our men's team has seen the return of Champions League football to Old Trafford."

- Carrick quashes notion Manchester United are out of shape

- Mikel Arteta agrees a new long-term contract extension with Arsenal - sources

In the press release which accompanied the results, United said: "the club continues on its journey to improve operational efficiency and financial sustainability."

A United source said "stabilising the business has required, and will continue to require, hard work and financial discipline."

Among the expenditures for the year was £8.2m ($11m) paid to Ruben Amorim and his staff after the Portuguese coach was dismissed in January. United saved around £8.5m ($11.3m) after Amorim accepted the head coach job at AC Milan in the summer.

The club also paid off around £150m ($199m) from a revolving credit facility between March and June.

Meanwhile, United's finances revealed they paid £63.5m ($84m) for land associated with plans to build a new stadium.

Berrada said: "Our other main area of focus is our plan to develop a new 100,000 seater stadium. We have now completed the major milestone of securing the land which will form part of the proposed location of the new stadium."

articles.headlineJa: NBAランキング2026：選外、驚きの結果、内部関係者の反応
articles.descriptionJa: レブロン、ステフ、KDの順位は妥当だったのか？NBAの内部関係者が、今年のランキングにおける最大の選外、サプライズ、そして予測について詳しく解説します。
articles.body:
ESPN continues its countdown of the top 100 players entering the 2026-27 NBA season after rolling out 50-11 today and 100-51 on Monday.

LeBron James, Stephen Curry and Kevin Durant continue their reign near the top of NBA rank as some of the longest-tenured players in the league. But what new faces made their debut?

Before we reveal the top 10 best players in the league, our expert panel breaks down this year's list, answering the biggest questions on surprise snubs and who's up next to break through the rankings.

LeBron James' No. 18 ranking is _____.

Jamal Collier: Questionable. What's the argument for LeBron still being ranked several spots behind the other "old guys" of his generation -- Curry, Durant or Kawhi Leonard?

LeBron carried the Los Angeles Lakers to a playoff series win last year with Luka Doncic injured and Austin Reaves out for most of the series against the Houston Rockets. Injured or not, Durant hasn't won a playoff series since 2023. Curry is still the engine for the Golden State Warriors but didn't get out of the play-in tournament and has played fewer games than LeBron. Leonard is coming off one of the best regular seasons of his career, but he's far from reliable from a health perspective.

LeBron transitioned into a new role with the Lakers and, after an adjustment period, excelled. It might take some time for everyone to adjust in Philly, but James has continued to be as consistent a bet as nearly everyone ahead of him.

Tim MacMahon: Fair. At the ripe age of 41, he's still a legitimate All-Star, which is an unprecedented feat in NBA history. But James is a cut below All-NBA-caliber at this point in his legendary career. He's no longer capable of being the best player on a championship contender, but there has never been a better bargain on a veterans minimum contract.

Anthony Slater: A hint at both the talent glut and offensive challenges ahead for the Sixers. James is behind two of his younger teammates in this rank. Tyrese Maxey (No. 11) is exploding into his prime, and Jaylen Brown (No. 14) is coming off a top-six MVP finish. James had to rearrange his game to take a supplementary role last season next to Doncic and Reaves (when both were healthy). Finding that sweet spot when sharing the floor with Maxey and Brown will define Philadelphia's season.

Brian Windhorst: Appropriate. After the All-Star break last season, LeBron shot 54% and averaged seven rebounds and seven assists while having the lowest usage rate of his career. He morphed midyear into one of the best transition scorers in the league and an off-ball cutter. Had he played five more games and gotten to 65, he very well could have made the All-NBA team.

Which player's ranking surprised you the most?

Collier: Tyrese Haliburton at No. 19 is too low. Haliburton played like a top 10 player during the 2025 playoffs, and he has had more than enough time to recover from an Achilles tear. His regular-season stats might not be as gaudy as some of the guys ah

articles.descriptionJa: 水曜日のMLBの試合に向けてファンタジーベースボールのラインナップを設定するのに必要な全情報。
articles.body:
Check out all of our starting pitcher rankings and other lineup selection tools here to help you make smart fantasy baseball lineup decisions. All fantasy advice is geared toward ESPN 10-team leagues with standard scoring.

Note: All information is accurate as of the time of publication. For updates, as well as any breaking news that might impact today's MLB slate, be sure to check out the latest fantasy baseball buzz. 

Other resources: RP depth chart | 2026 Rankings

ESPN's 2026 Player Rater | Betting notes for Wednesday

Pitchers to stream on Wednesday

Spoiler alert: This is not the ideal slate to make up points in pitching. Connor Prielipp leads the way after posting a 2.70 ERA and 0.94 WHIP over his last five outings with 24 strikeouts in 26 2/3 innings. The Minnesota Twins are on the road against the San Francisco Giants, so the right-hander will work in a pitcher-friendly park and face a depleted lineup missing Rafael Devers and Bryce Eldridge.

Walbert Urena hopes to end his rookie season on a roll when the Los Angeles Angels visit the Athletics. The 22-year-old righty has completed at least six frames over his last four outings, posting a 1.93 ERA and 0.86 WHIP with 28 punchouts to just three free passes over 28 frames. Sutter Health Park has been a nightmare for pitchers most of the season, but the temperatures should be in the high 70s and the Athletics' injury-riddled lineup has struggled at home for a month.

Hitters to stream on Wednesday

The Arizona Diamondbacks face the Colorado Rockies at Coors Field. Lars Nootbaar has been leading off for the Diamondbacks against right-handers, and the Rockies will send Mason Adams and his 5.09 ERA to the hill.

The Minnesota Twins are playing out the string, but Royce Lewis and Ryan Jeffers are hoping to end the season on a high note. The club is on the road against the San Francisco Giants, with lefty Cesar Perdomo getting the call. His 3.72 ERA is misleading, considering he's fanned only 12 while issuing seven walks and yielding three homers in just 19 1/3 innings.

Paul Goldschmidt should be leading off when the New York Yankees take on the lefty Steven Matz and the Tampa Bay Rays. Goldschmidt's role has fluctuated this season, but he's been productive with the platoon edge, batting .309/.404/.592 versus southpaws.

After three hitless games upon returning from a long absence, Konnor Griffin has a .283/.333/.396 line over his past dozen contests. He'll enjoy the platoon edge when the Pittsburgh Pirates host the St. Louis Cardinals and lefty Matthew Liberatore. Griffin's power stroke is lacking, but Liberatore has served up 27 long balls in only 149 1/3 innings.

articles.headline: Zack Wheeler fans 7 straight to open Phillies win over Brewers
articles.description: Zack Wheeler struck out 11, including seven in a row to start the game, and Bryson Stott hit a tiebreaking single with two outs in the eighth inning as the Phillies inched closer to clinching a playoff spot with a 6-4 victory over the Brewers.
articles.headlineJa: ザック・ウィーラーが初回から7者連続三振、フィリーズがブルワーズを下す
articles.descriptionJa: ザック・ウィーラーが試合開始からの7者連続を含む11奪三振を記録し、8回2死からブライソン・ストットが勝ち越し打を放って、フィリーズが6-4でブルワーズに勝利し、プレーオフ進出確定へと一歩近づきました。
articles.body:
Zack Wheeler struck out 11, including seven in a row to start the game, and Bryson Stott hit a tiebreaking single with two outs in the eighth inning as the Philadelphia Phillies inched closer to clinching a playoff spot with a 6-4 victory over the Milwaukee Brewers on Tuesday night.

Wheeler reached 2,000 career strikeouts when he fanned Brice Turang to end the first, becoming the 96th pitcher in MLB history to reach the milestone.

"Just being where I am now, it's pretty special," Wheeler said of the career milestone, according to MLB.com. "It's a huge thank you to all the catchers that I've had along the way that helped me get here, the coaches and the guys that played behind me. It means a lot to me, and I really appreciate everybody's effort around it."

Unhittable at the outset, Wheeler had sights on Pablo López's MLB record of nine strikeouts in a row to open a contest before Cooper Pratt grounded out to third base for the second out of the third inning.

"I didn't know what to expect coming out," Wheeler said. "Just one of those days for me."

Wheeler is the only Phillies pitcher since 1900 with seven straight strikeouts to start a game, according to the Elias Sports Bureau. Watching Wheeler from the dugout was teammate Aaron Nola, who has a share of the MLB record with 10 consecutive strikeouts of the New York Mets in 2021.

Brandon Marsh homered, doubled and drove in three runs for Philadelphia, which is tied with the Chicago Cubs and San Diego Padres at 87-70 for the three National League wild cards -- four games ahead of the Arizona Diamondbacks with five to play. The Phillies hold a tiebreaker over the Padres but not the Cubs.

William Contreras had three RBIs for NL Central champion Milwaukee. The Brewers, by virtue of Cincinnati's 4-0 win over Atlanta, clinched a bye in the wild-card round and earned home-field advantage for the division series. The Brewers dropped to 13-6 this month and were not able to extend their franchise record of 98 wins, set in Sunday's 3-0 victory at Baltimore.

After the Brewers scored twice in the sixth inning off Wheeler to tie the game at 3, Stott singled to center off Colton Gordon (0-1). Garrett Mitchell's throw went to third base to try to get Alec Bohm running from first, but the ball ricocheted off Bohm's foot and both he and Luis Arraez scored to make it 5-3.

Jhoan Duran earned his 33rd save after Jose Alvarado (5-3) got the final out of the eighth.

The Associated Press contributed to this report.

articles.headline: Fantasy football consistency ratings: 2024 to 2026
articles.description: The consistency ratings weigh both how consistent and how start-worthy players have been from 2024 to 2026.
articles.headlineJa: ファンタジーフットボールの一貫性評価：2024年〜2026年
articles.descriptionJa: この一貫性評価は、2024年から2026年までの選手のパフォーマンスの安定性と、先発起用する価値の双方を考慮しています。
articles.body:
Updated Sept. 22, 2026 (through Week 2 of 2026)

How consistency ratings work

Using fantasy points determined by ESPN's standard scoring, the charts contained in this column rate players based upon how consistently reliable they have been during the 2024 through 2026 seasons, a span of 38 weeks' worth of games (18 weeks apiece in 2024 and 2025, two so far in 2026). For IDPs (individual defensive players), the scoring from our weekly rankings is used: solo tackle (1.5), assisted tackle (0.75), tackle for loss (2), sack (4), interception (5), forced fumble (4), fumble recovery (4), touchdown (6), safety (2), pass defended (1.5). To familiarize you with the terminology and column headers listed in the charts below:

Start%: The player's "start percentage," which shows how often he earned a start in an ESPN standard PPR (points per reception) league. This is his number of "starts" -- those defined below -- divided by his number of scheduled team games.

CR: The player's "consistency rating," which is calculated as his weekly standard deviation divided by his PPR fantasy points per game average. This is meant to identify the players who were most consistently close to their weekly averages. The lower the number, the more consistent the player. Again, lower numbers are better.

nPPR%: The player's start percentage using non-PPR scoring, using ESPN's standard scoring settings without any points per reception.

FPTS/G: The player's average PPR fantasy points scored per game.

Start: The number of times that the player's point total in a given week was worthy of having had him active in an ESPN standard PPR league.

Star: The number of times the player's point total ranked among the best at his position.

Stiff: The number of times the player's point total ranked among the worst at his position, making almost any waiver-wire option a smarter choice.

These are the benchmarks for what constitutes a "start," "star" or "stiff" performance:

Sat: The number of times the player sat out a game. Players are not charged "stiff" points for sitting out, nor does it impact their overall consistency rating (CR), but it hurts their overall start percentage.

Players must have a start rate of at least 20% in either standard PPR or non-PPR scoring, rank among the top 20 quarterbacks, tight ends or kickers, top 50 running backs or wide receivers, or top 40 defensive linemen, linebackers or defensive backs, in terms of total fantasy points at their position from 2023 to 2025, or are averaging at least 50 snaps per game, for inclusion in the chart. All defense/special teams are included regardless of whether they meet those minimums.
